highlights: The next level of wireless audio is here for you with Green Lion Cairo Wireless Earbuds.
It's equipped with Bluetooth version 5.3 and you can rely on a stable connection within a 12-meter range.
Navigate with multi-function touch controls for hands-free calls and intuitive playback.
You have 25mAh earphone capacity and 200mAh charging box, so it'll provide you with 4.5 hours of talk time and 4 hours of continuous playtime just with a single charge.
These earbuds feature an IPX4 waterresistant rating, so rest assured about its durability against sweat and rain.
